factorSources.note: The Infatuation rates Post Alley Pizza 8.1 ('Great'), praising the charred, chewy NY-style crust and the granulated garlic shaker for slices, which it says it hasn't found at other Seattle slice shops.

The Infatuation rates Hot Mama's 6.1 ('It's Fine'), saying the pesto slice is very good but the red (tomato) slices taste like almost nothing; The Seattle Spectator's by-the-slice review (6.5/10) found the pepperoni slice greasy and structurally weak with a 'disheartening flop,' though it praised the cheese pull and sauce.

mentions.title: Hot Mama's pesto slice is very good, but ignore the others
